# The Peninsular Company

> The Peninsular Company, LLC is a privately held company in Detroit, Michigan. It builds brands, websites, software, and marketing for businesses, advises auction houses on technology, and develops apps and ventures of its own. Its principal is Joe Lint.

Every client engagement has a fixed scope and a fixed price, quoted before work starts. Contact: hello@thepeninsularcompany.com or (313) 528-2200.

## Services

- [Marketing and websites for manufacturers](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/manufacturing/): Branding, website design, marketing, and software for manufacturers and industrial companies. Example: Lotus International.
- [Websites and marketing for contractors and home-service companies](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/home-services/): Branding, website design, paid advertising, and direct mail. Example: Clark Basement Waterproofing.
- [Branding and websites for life-sciences companies](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/life-sciences/): Brand, website design, and messaging for clinical software and other technical products. Example: TrialAssure.
- [Software, websites, and advisory for auction houses](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/auction-houses/): Cataloging, websites and online bidding, marketing to consignors and bidders, and operations, plus Theca, auction management software opening in 2027.
- [Web design, branding, and marketing in Detroit](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/detroit/): The same services for businesses in metro Detroit and across Michigan. Example: Hunt Sign Co.

## Selected work

- [Hunt Sign Co.](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/work/hunt-sign/): Website, copywriting, and search optimization for a family-run commercial sign shop in Berkley, Michigan.
- [Lotus International](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/work/lotus-international/): Branding, website, and marketing for a contract manufacturer in Canton, Michigan. In-house work by Joe Lint.
- [Clark Basement Waterproofing](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/work/clark-waterproofing/): Branding, website, paid advertising, and direct mail for a family-owned company in Mount Clemens, Michigan.
- [TrialAssure](https://thepeninsularcompany.com/work/trialassure/): Branding and website for a maker of clinical trial software in Canton, Michigan.

## Products

- [Daily Canvas](https://dailycanvasapp.com): A painting every morning on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV, chosen from public-domain works in museums' open collections.
- [Heirloom](https://heirloomapp.io): A home inventory app for iPhone and the web that builds an inventory an insurer can use.
- Theca: Auction management software for regional fine and decorative arts auction houses. Opens in 2027.
- [Codekeeper](https://codekeeper.app): Meetings, dues, a website, and continuing-education records for Michigan building-official associations.
